products.name: OneDrive for Business — Commercial
products.short_description: Silently back up every user's Desktop, Documents, and Pictures to the cloud. Do it yourself with self-guided, tested steps — far cheaper than consulting.
products.description:
Silent, automatic file backup and ransomware resilience

When files live only on a laptop, one lost, stolen, or wiped device means lost work — and a ransomware hit can take a whole team offline. OneDrive for Business turns every user's Desktop, Documents, and Pictures into cloud-backed, version-protected, roam-anywhere storage — silently, with zero action from the user.

Run it yourself — simpler, cheaper, and proven

You do not need a consultant on site to deploy OneDrive for Business. This package hands you the exact, field-tested method as self-guided, click-by-click documentation that a non-expert administrator can follow from start to finish — backed by ready-to-run PowerShell scripts that do the heavy lifting. You implement with confidence, on your own schedule, and keep the playbook forever.

  • Simpler — exact navigation in the right order, written for a novice admin. Click to implement; the “why” lives in the overview so the steps stay short and uncluttered.
  • Cheaper — one fixed, transparent price instead of an open meter. A comparable consulting engagement runs $1,500–$3,000 per day across several days; this is a fraction of that, with nothing left to bill.
  • Tested — a pilot-first method (Assess → Configure → Pilot → Validate → Expand) with validation scripts and clear pass/fail gates, so you know it worked before you roll out to the fleet.

What's inside

  • Solution Overview — Silent Sign-In, Known Folder Move, and Files On-Demand explained in plain language.
  • Requirements Guide — every prerequisite with how to verify and implement if missing.
  • Implementation Guide — exact, ordered Intune Settings Catalog steps.
  • 5 PowerShell scripts — Tenant ID retrieval, readiness discovery, configuration validation, usage reporting (Microsoft Graph), and safe remediation.
  • Testing & Troubleshooting Guides with pass/fail gates, plus Best Practices.

The repeatable way

Every solution follows the same repeatable shape, so each one you deploy feels familiar and low-risk — and your team gets faster and more confident with every rollout. Buy once, deploy to unlimited devices, and reuse the playbook for the next wave and the next project.

The bottom line

Automatic, silent file protection across the fleet: ransomware and device-loss resilience, seamless roaming between devices, and far fewer ‘I lost my files’ tickets — deployable by one administrator and validated before you expand.

What you receive — every file in your download

This package is delivered as downloadable files you keep and reuse across unlimited devices — nothing is left out and nothing else is required:

  • Implementation Guide (PDF) — the complete, click-by-click solution: solution overview, requirements, step-by-step implementation, testing & validation, troubleshooting, best practices.
  • PowerShell Scripts (ZIP) — 5 ready-to-run scripts (read-only discovery/validation/reporting; remediation defaults to a safe preview):
    • Get-TenantId.ps1 — retrieve the Microsoft Entra Tenant ID needed for Known Folder Move
    • ODFB-Discovery.ps1 — OneDrive for Business device readiness check
    • ODFB-Remediation.ps1 — safe remediation for OneDrive for Business configuration/sync issues
    • ODFB-TenantReport.ps1 — tenant-wide OneDrive for Business usage report via Microsoft Graph
    • ODFB-Validation.ps1 — confirm OneDrive for Business is configured for the signed-in user

Delivered as a branded Word document and PDF, plus all five PowerShell scripts in a single ZIP — yours to keep and reuse across unlimited devices.
